headline: Marketplace H100 SXM and H200 prices jump while hyperscaler and neocloud rates hold steady.
bullets: H200's market index rose +6% to $5.72 over 7 days, driven by a +14% marketplace move while hyperscaler and neocloud segments were +0%.
H100 SXM's index reads +0% at $4.62, but that hides a +17% jump in its marketplace segment to $2.94.
B200 held at an $8.50 index with no segment moves, and RunPod Community Cloud remains its cheapest provider at $5.98.
Across all 11 tracked GPUs, H100 NVL offers the best price-performance at $3.59 per PFLOP-hour and the widest hyperscaler premium at +184%.
Among headline GPUs, H100 SXM carries the steepest hyperscaler premium at +140%, with a $10.68 hyperscaler median versus $4.45 at neoclouds.
watch: Whether the marketplace gains in H100 SXM (+17%) and H200 (+14%) spread to neocloud pricing, which has stayed +0% for both.
